::: {.callout-important}
## Module 3 is required
[Module 3](module3.qmd) is a prerequisite. This session is hands-on project work,
not instruction, and it assumes you can already choose and run an appropriate
statistical test.
:::

A session for the intermediate R user to practise **end-to-end data analysis**.

We use dummy datasets organised the same way as the main ABCD dataset to ask basic
scientific questions. You will:

- build a hypothesis
- decide on the appropriate statistical test
- use R to run the analysis and produce the visualisations

The goal is to leave with results of the kind you would put on a **scientific
poster** at a conference.

## Preparation

- [Module 3](module3.qmd) — required
- Bring a question you are curious about, if you have one. Otherwise we supply
  them.
